base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: Tavily API root used by both tools, for example https://api.tavily.com. Do not append /search or /extract.

timeout_seconds.title: Search and Extract timeout
timeout_seconds.description: Total time budget in seconds for one Search or Extract call, including retries.

site_timeout_seconds.title: Crawl and Map timeout
site_timeout_seconds.description: Total client-side time budget in seconds for one Crawl or Map call, including retries. Tavily's server-side default is 150 seconds.

max_retries.title: Retry count
max_retries.description: Additional attempts for HTTP 408, 429, and 5xx responses or network failures.

default_max_results.title: Default result count
default_max_results.description: Maximum number of results used when the search tool omits max_results.

default_search_depth.title: Default search depth
default_search_depth.description: Search depth used when the search tool omits search_depth. Advanced uses more credits and latency.

chunks_per_source.title: Chunks per result
chunks_per_source.description: Maximum content chunks returned per search result. Basic and fast chunks are about 500 characters; advanced chunks are about 800.

default_extract_depth.title: Default extraction depth
default_extract_depth.description: Extraction depth used when the extract tool omits extract_depth. Advanced uses more credits and latency.

default_format.title: Default extraction format
default_format.description: Format used when the extract tool omits format.
